name: pack-s-0010
comment: Fable's profile S, small (streams-cost report 2026-10-24, section 4.1), 10 projects on one launch cell (the packing measurement, README 'Packing'): each project 20 streams of 1 KiB JSON singles at 2 appends a second (open-loop Poisson), a long-poll tail on every stream, one consumer group (pull max 10, settle each, 20 s waits) on 5 of the streams, which take a quarter of the appends: 25 parked waits a project (20 tails, a pull loop per group stream). Creates 0.1 s apart (20 x 11 of a project's store budget). Setup 0-120 s, the load 180-1,640 s (projects start spread over 60 s; writers stop 20 s or more before the readers), the verdict window 'steady' 360-1,560 s (20 min). The class pool holds every project's waits at once.
